The season began on 14 August 2025 and concluded on 17 April 2026.{{Cite news|last=|first=|url=https://www.qsl.qa/en/news/announcing-2025-2026-season-qatar-stars-league-first-leg-schedule|title=Announcing the 2025-2026 season Qatar Stars League first leg schedule|website=QSL|date=22 June 2025|access-date=30 June 2025| archive-date=18 July 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250718080516/https://www.qsl.qa/en/news/announcing-2025-2026-season-qatar-stars-league-first-leg-schedule|url-status=live}} [[Al Sadd SC|Al Sadd]] were defending champions, having won the [[2024–25 Qatar Stars League|previous season]].
